journeys.en: Customer books an on-site repair (P01 → payment)

steps.desc: Customer opens app / portal, Bengali UI, picks device + symptom
Identity via OTP — golden record matched or created
Service resolved with upfront price + slot (≤3 steps)
AI scores candidates → assigned → ETA published to customer
Job accepted, navigation, photos w/ GPS, fix, e-sign
Quality checkpoint gate → repair warranty issued
Token issued, fast intake, device condition photos
L1/L2/L3 routing; parts from branch store
Serial-tracked consumption; consignment hard block respected
Customer books pick & drop with slot
Multi-leg journey planned; seal number issued
Scan + OTP + photos at every custody handover
Repair executed under custody state ON BENCH
Delivery leg with OTP + signature + COD if due
Warranty order — entitlement says brand pays
Auto-created on delivery; evidence pack assembled <5 min
Photos, diagnostics, parts genealogy, certification proof
